description: Author-only: declare a locked USDC prize on your benchmark (API key required). Poster-funded: this records the prize pending and never broadcasts; the response's poster_instructions list the wallet steps you sign. Needs a withdrawal_address on your owner account. Args: slug, amount_usdc, threshold_bps, payout_rule, closes_at, plus the optional BountyConfig fields. Returns the benchmark detail. REST twin: POST /api/v1/benchmarks/{slug}/prize. Custodial authors: benchmarks_prize_fund next.

inputSchema.description: ``benchmarks_prize_attach``: the REST prize body plus the slug.

allowed_entrants.description: Closed entrant set as checksummed 0x addresses (empty = open entry).
allowed_entrants.title: Allowed Entrants

amount_usdc.description: Prize pool in USDC. You lock it on-chain from your own wallet via the steps the attach response carries (the platform never funds bounties).
amount_usdc.title: Amount Usdc

claim_deadline.description: UTC deadline for winners to claim on-chain (default closes_at + 30d).
claim_deadline.title: Claim Deadline

entry_fee.description: Entrant fee in USDC, pulled from each entrant's own wallet by enter() (0 = free entry; USDC has 6 decimals).
entry_fee.title: Entry Fee

grading_grace_seconds.description: Post-close grading grace in seconds (0 = the v1 reclaim race preserved). Non-zero must fit inside the claim window: grading_grace_seconds <= claim_deadline - closes_at.
grading_grace_seconds.title: Grading Grace Seconds

max_entrants.description: Entrant cap (0 = uncapped; the on-chain width is a uint16 — 65535 max).
max_entrants.title: Max Entrants

payout_rule.description: winner_take_all: single winner takes the pool. top_n_split: top three split it 50/30/20. In frozen mode (non-empty splits_bps) this rule is METADATA ONLY on-chain: the frozen splits govern the payout shape, and the platform sizes every place from them.
payout_rule.title: Payout Rule

slug.description: Benchmark slug from benchmarks_list or benchmarks_search. Optional on a /mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http session (defaults to that benchmark).
slug.title: Slug

splits_bps.description: Winner share per payout place in bps, frozen at creation (empty = operator-amounts mode). Non-empty splits GOVERN the award on-chain: at most splits_bps.length winners can be paid (TooManyWinners), and the platform must grant place i exactly pool * splits_bps[i] / 10_000 (SplitMismatch otherwise) — the payout_rule is metadata only in this mode. Each element is a non-zero place share of 1..10000; the cumulative sum must stay within 10000 — the remainder stays in the pool (a full 10000 sum is NOT required).
splits_bps.title: Splits Bps

threshold_bps.description: Score threshold in basis points of the composite ceiling (0..10000; 8500 = a 0.8500 composite). Runs below it are not eligible for the prize.
threshold_bps.title: Threshold Bps

inputSchema.title: BenchmarkPrizeAttachInput

name: benchmarks_prize_attach
